steps: Let T = 252. The first base ratio gives area ABD = 3T/4 and area ADC = T/4.
AE:AC = 1:2, so area ADE = T/8. Comparing heights on base AD gives BP:PE = 6:1.
Area ABE = T/2. Thus area ABP = (6/7) × T/2 = 3T/7 = 108 cm².
For the next corner, area BCE = 1T/2. Because BF:BA = 1:3, area BEF = T/6.
BCE and BEF share base BE. Their height ratio gives CQ:QF = 3:1.
Area BCF = T/3, so area BCQ = (3/4) × T/3 = 1T/4 = 63 cm².
For the last corner, area CAF = 2T/3. Since CD:CB = 1:4, area CFD = T/12.
CAF and CFD share base CF. Their height ratio gives AR:RD = 8:1.
Area CAD = T/4, so area CAR = (8/9) × T/4 = 2T/9 = 56 cm².
These three corner triangles fill the unshaded region without overlap. PQR has area 252 − 108 − 63 − 56 = 25 cm².
